title: dysoxylum bijugum
intro: Dysoxylum bijugum, commonly known as East Indian white cedar or East Indian white teak, is a species of plant in the family Meliaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, combat infections, and neutralize free radicals in the body. The bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum bijugum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
